scope:
IN SCOPE — three text-rendering sites need to move onto a shared `formatTime(hhmm, prefs)` next to the #207 preference read (`$lib/preferences/timeFormat.ts`'s `timeFormatStore`), all currently hardcoded to 24h regardless of the viewer's AM/PM preference:

1. **`src/lib/components/agenda/AgendaList.svelte:198-203`** — `timeFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Europe/Tallinn', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false })`. Rendered at **line 353** (`recent-row` time span, right after `shortDateFmt`) and **line 478** (`data-testid="row-time"`, main day-group rows). Both `timeFmt.format(new Date(item.startDatetime))`.
2. **`src/routes/event/[id]/+page.svelte:606-611`** — identical `timeFmt` (`en-GB`, `hour12: false`, TZ Tallinn; comment explicitly says "same TZ + HH:MM formatter as AgendaList.svelte — verbatim T5 build spec convention"). Feeds `timeRange()` (**lines 675-681**, single time or `start–end` range) rendered at **lines 1848 and 1859** (`data-testid="event-detail-time"`, header + body variants).
3. **`src/routes/+page.svelte:2784-2792`** — `eventCreateStatusTimeFmt` (`en-GB`, `hourCycle: 'h23'`, TZ Tallinn) composed with `eventCreateStatusDateFmt` inside `eventCreateStatusFmt(at)` → `"${date} ${time}"`. Consumed at **line 3850** as `when: eventCreateStatusFmt(new Date(startDatetime))`, interpolated into the Paraglide message `event_created` = `"{name} created for {when}."` (`messages/en.json:433`) — the event-creation success toast. Only the TIME half of `when` is in scope; the date half must stay ISO (rule 7).

No other rendered-time-as-text sites exist on `main`. `TimeSelect.svelte` (the #207 input composite) already reads `timeFormatStore` itself for its own hour/minute/AM-PM `<select>`s — it is an editable control, not a display, and is already preference-aware; no change needed there.

implementationNotes:
Rule-7 DATE formatters that sit right next to the in-scope time formatters and must NOT change: `eventCreateStatusDateFmt` (paired 1:1 with `eventCreateStatusTimeFmt` inside `eventCreateStatusFmt`, +page.svelte:2778-2783), `seasonDateFmt` (+page.svelte:2338-2343), `_dateFmt` (library/+page.svelte:55-60), `expiryDateFmt` (invite/[token]/+page.svelte:35-39), `inviteExpiryDateFmt` (InviteSurface.svelte:108-112), `groupKeyFmt`/`shortDateFmt` (AgendaList.svelte:182-187, 210-215). Two more date formatters are pre-existing LOCALE-rendered (not ISO) and explicitly marked "preserved verbatim, do not touch": `headerFmt` (AgendaList.svelte:190-195, "Monday, 15 June") and `dateFmt` (event/[id]/+page.svelte:616-620) — these look like they'd trip rule 7 on a naive read but the team has already carved them out; #220 should leave them exactly as-is regardless.

Suggested formatTime(hhmm, prefs) placement: co-locate in `src/lib/preferences/timeFormat.ts` next to `timeFormatStore`/`readStoredTimeFormat`, taking a 24h `HH:MM` string (or the two Date objects the three call sites already have) and the current `TimeFormat` value, returning either `"HH:MM"` (unset/24h) or `"H:MM AM/PM"` (ampm mode, spec's own example is "7:00 PM" — no leading zero on the hour, space before AM/PM). All three sites already build their 24h string via an `Intl.DateTimeFormat` `.format()` call against a `Date` in the Tallinn TZ; the shared helper's cleanest seam is likely to accept the already-formatted 24h `HH:MM` (each site keeps its own TZ-aware Intl formatter to produce that) and re-render per preference, OR to accept the Date + TZ directly and do both passes internally — worth a quick brainstorm/RED-writer decision since the three call shapes differ slightly (AgendaList: bare Date; event detail: a computed range via `timeRange()`; +page.svelte: a composed date+time toast string built by string-concatenating two separate formatters).
blastRadius: Three files change: `src/lib/components/agenda/AgendaList.svelte` (2 render call sites), `src/routes/event/[id]/+page.svelte` (`timeRange()` + its 2 render sites), `src/routes/+page.svelte` (`eventCreateStatusFmt`'s time half, 1 render site via the `event_created` toast). Plus one new/extended module: `src/lib/preferences/timeFormat.ts` gains the shared `formatTime` export. No wire-format, storage, or ISO-timestamp changes anywhere — every in-scope site is a pure display transform downstream of an already-correct 24h Intl format. No Entu payload, no `startDatetime`/`timeOfDay` value, no date-only formatter is touched.
crossCuttingAxes: Locale/i18n: the three sites currently pin `'en-GB'`/`hourCycle:'h23'` specifically to force 24h REGARDLESS of browser locale (that's rule 5's whole point for inputs, and these display sites copied the convention) — the new `formatTime` must keep that same locale-independence in both modes (AM/PM output should not vary by browser locale either, per the spec's fixed "7:00 PM" example) rather than reintroducing a `toLocaleTimeString`-style leak. Timezone: all three sites are Tallinn-wall-clock; the shared helper takes an already-Tallinn-resolved value/string, it does not itself need TZ awareness. Reactivity: AgendaList and event/[id] currently build their formatters as page-load-time `const`s (not `$derived`) — since the preference can change live (profile page), the call sites (or the formatters themselves) need to become reactive to `$timeFormatStore`, same pattern `TimeSelect.svelte` already uses (`const mode = $derived($timeFormatStore)`).
standingRuleHits: Rule 5 (native time/datetime-local INPUT controls, 24h default + AM/PM opt-in) — already fully satisfied, not this issue's concern; flagged only so the RED writer doesn't conflate #220 with a rule-5 gap. Rule 7 (ISO date display) — explicitly must NOT be touched by #220; all six date-only formatters plus the two "preserved verbatim" locale-date formatters are enumerated above so GREEN doesn't accidentally sweep them in. Bentham's review triggers `[TRIGGER-24H-TIME]`/`[TRIGGER-ISO-DATE]` in architecture-decisions.md:844,846 are the two guardrails this slice sits between.
